text:
sarah: Hey @mike @kevin @anna — can you take runtime/infra/security eyes on PR #62111? It's a hotfix for the KV cache memory leak we've been seeing in staging. Planning a canary rollout tomorrow 10:30 PT (2 instances). Link: https://git.redwood/pr/62111

mike: on it. quick q: does this change eviction thresholds or just the allocator bug?

sarah: allocator bug only (prefetch path). No threshold changes. Test plan: smoke (write/read load), check mem usage, trace logs. Patch includes this snippet for the allocator guard:
```diff
- if (cache.size() > limit) evict();
+ if (cache.size() > limit && !in_prefetch) evict();
```

kevin: infra - we need the manifest change for node label and a canary pool. Add below to helm patch and I can schedule pool:
```yaml
affinity:
  nodeSelector:
    runtime-role: canary-eviction
replicas: 2
```

anna: security - quick ask: any new surface for untrusted prompts? My quick scan shows no user-facing change. Please add an audit log event id when rollback runs.

sarah: will add audit event "kv_alloc_fix_rollout" and include in PR.

jordan: I'll take merge owner for the window. Can we aim for 10:35 PT so oncall can monitor?

mike: LGTM from runtime pending infra canary patch. left one nit in code comment.

kevin: infra +1 for scheduling; please push the helm patch and tag me.

deploy-bot: CI: unit tests ✅, integration tests ✅, canary deploy job queued.

sarah: pushed helm patch, added audit log, addressed nit. Tagging @kevin @mike @anna for final ack. Thanks!

mike: :thumbsup: acked. will watch canary.

kevin: acked. scheduling pool now.

anna: :+1: security ack. please include the audit log entry in release notes.

sarah: thanks all. I'll open a follow-up thread with rollback playbook and smoke checklist.
